positions.as_written: Use the post-operative protocol, since suture material and any implant produce local artefact at exactly the site in question.
Compare with the earliest post-operative study available, which turns the appearance into a trend.
Assess for displacement, which is the finding that does not depend on signal.
Assess the position of the body, because a repair that has not restored the anchor leaves the meniscus extruded.
Repair restores continuity, so it should restore the circumferential tension, and persistent extrusion after repair says it has not.
